title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper Neutralization…
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This flaw allows an attacker with local access to execute arbitrary commands on the appliance, potentially escalating privileges and fully compromising confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
